description: Prepare (unsigned) leaving public feedback for an ERC-8004 agent on the reputation registry: giveFeedback(agentId, value, decimals, tag1, tag2, endpoint, feedbackURI). The registry refuses feedback from the agent's own owner or agent wallet, so this refuses it first. Feedback is permanent, public and linked to your wallet. Tags are short words such as tokyofuturo and job. Your wallet signs and pays gas.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 id you are reviewing.

endpoint.description: Optional: the service endpoint the feedback is about (https, up to 200 characters).

feedbackURI.description: Optional: https:// link with the details (up to 300 characters).

tag1.description: Up to 32 characters, for example tokyofuturo.

tag2.description: Up to 32 characters, for example job.

value.description: A whole number score, for example 5 or 85. Use valueDecimals for fractions.

name: erc8004_prepare_feedback
